<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % intEnt "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Internal Entity'>">
  %intEnt;
  <!ENTITY extSys SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY banner SYSTEM "banner.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Root level comment combining namespaces and entities -->
  <sub:child xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup-like text: <sub:child>&internal;</sub:child>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY prefix "DATA_">
  <!ENTITY combined "&prefix;SUFFIX">
  <!ENTITY % paramDecl "<!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA | subrec)*>">
  %paramDecl;
  <!ELEMENT subrec (#PCDATA)>
]>
<?target-pi data="processing-instruction-value"?>
<database xmlns="http://www.xml.org/database" xmlns:m="http://www.xml.org/metadata">
  <!-- Metadata and processing instructions inside root -->
  <?xml-meta version="1.0"?>
  <m:record id="rec1">
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA block with entity reference &combined; inside.
    ]]>
  </m:record>
  <record>&combined;</record>
</database>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Second Entity">
  <!ENTITY % dtdMacro "<!ENTITY macroEnt 'Macro Value'>">
  %dtdMacro;
]>
<?catalog-control mode="strict"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Catalog containing multiple CDATA and entity references -->
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block with &ent2;
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      Second CDATA block with ¯oEnt;
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (file)*>
  <!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY baseEnt "Base Entity String">
  <!ENTITY nestedEnt "&baseEnt; - Extended">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "document.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-script type="text/javascript" src="parser.js"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.net/archive" xmlns:v="http://example.net/version">
  <!-- Archive description comment -->
  <v:file id="f1">
    <![CDATA[
      Archive content containing entities: &nestedEnt;
    ]]>
  </v:file>
  <file>&nestedEnt;</file>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock)*>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY stockA "Item A">
  <!ENTITY stockB "Item B: &stockA;">
  <!ENTITY % batch "<!ENTITY stockC 'Item C'>">
  %batch;
]>
<?xml-app test="true"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.com/inventory" xmlns:ns="http://example.com/ns">
  <!-- Inventory tracking comment block -->
  <ns:stock id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      Inventory notes: &stockB; and &stockC;
    ]]>
  </ns:stock>
  <stock>&stockB;</stock>
</inventory>
```
